articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Mode of Industrial Robots under the Modern Industrial College Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Modern industrial college is one of the achievements of the innovation of higher education organization in recent years, and it is an important hand to deepen the integration of industry with education and promote collaborative education. As one of the main courses in the industrial robot application direction of automation, the industrial robot practice course has a direct impact on the employment of graduates in this direction. Includes three parts: offline simulation, industrial robotics physical practice, and project innovation practice. However, different from the traditional practical training experimental courses, industrial robotics practice on the strict environmental requirements, industrial robots required supporting equipment is difficult to meet the diversified needs of the project, the practical project and the needs of enterprises do not match and other issues have been plagued by universities to carry out the relevant practical courses. Therefore, relying on the industrial robotics training course of Beibu Gulf University, we propose the design and realization of an industrial robotics practical education model based on the PDCA cycle theory to give fully to students' autonomy and to improve the collaborative ability. Relying on the needs of enterprises to realize the continuous iteration of practical projects, give full play to the utilization rate of practical training equipment, and enhance the professional and technical capabilities of graduates in the direction of industrial robot application.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8n Helmet Detection Algorithm for Missed and False Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Aiming at the missed and false detection of helmet-wearing detection caused by a small target size or target being occluded in complex working scenarios. An improved helmet-wearing detection algorithm based on YOLOv8n is proposed. First, utilizing the BiFPN enhances the performance in detecting small targets and enhances the capability for generalization and feature fusion. Second, the incorporation of the CA attention mechanism into the backbone network aims to minimize the chances of misclassification, and enhance the precision of detection, thus optimizing the model performance. Finally, Introducing the SioU loss function improves the robustness of the detection. It is concluded from the experiments that the average accuracy of helmet-wearing detection improved from 93.0% to 94.9%, and the average accuracy of non-helmet-wearing detection improved from 91.3% to 92.4%, which is 1.9% and 1.1% respectively. The results show that the improved YOLOv8n algorithm can effectively improve the detection accuracy when the target size is small or the occlusion is missing.

articleTitle: Cycle-Consistent Generative Adversarial Network Augmented MobileNetV3 for Robust Grape Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Automating grape leaf disease classification is essential for reducing economic losses in agriculture. Traditional manual inspection methods are slow and subjective, underscoring the need for efficient machine learning solutions. This paper presents a novel system combining Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to improve grape leaf disease classification. GANs generate synthetic images of grape leaves at different disease stages, expanding the dataset for enhanced model generalization. A CNN, specifically MobileNetV3Large, is then applied to classify diseases using attention mechanisms to capture intricate patterns. The system was evaluated on a dataset of 5237 images representing five diseases (black rot, downy mildew, mosaic virus, black measles, and leaf blight) and healthy leaves. Compared to ResNet50, VGG16, EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNeXt, the proposed system achieved superior performance with an accuracy of 95.6%, precision of 94.3%, recall of 95.1%, and an F1 score of 94.7%, demonstrating its effectiveness for automated grape leaf disease detection.

articleTitle: Design of a Lower Limb Exoskeleton Rehabilitation Robot System Based on Forward Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robots can effectively improve the rehabilitation of stroke patients and can substantially reduce the workload of rehabilitation therapists and improve work efficiency. In this paper, we propose a method to investigate the influence of muscle groups on the hip joint during the gait cycle through kinetic modeling simulation. The method is validated using electromyographic signals (EMG). The patients are treated according to their gait characteristics. Simulation with OpenSim; optimisation by Scone controller; joint motion change curves were analysed by Matlab simulation to verify the correctness of the mathematical model, and the simulation showed excellent following effect. The feasibility of the theory is verified, and a new scheme is proposed for the treatment of stroke patients.

articleTitle: Data Transfer for YOLOv5 Based on Selector Network and Partial Pseudo-Labels
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: YOLOv5 is a widely used object detection method for its high-performance of balancing speed and accuracy. Data transfer for YOLOv5 is a challenging task, as it could involve domain shift between different datasets. We propose a data transfer method for YOLOv5 based on a Selector Network and Partial Pseudo-Labeling. The backbone network of YOLOv5 is used for feature extraction, a Selector Network is employed to filter source domain outlier samples to address the domain shift issue, and Partial Pseudo-Labels are leveraged to improve classification performance in the target domain. The results show that our method improves detection accuracy by an average of 2.4% on public datasets (COCO and VOC) and our datasets, with a notable improvement of 3.1% under complex backgrounds and varying lighting conditions. It demonstrates that our method can effectively enhances the accuracy and stability of YOLOv5.

articleTitle: Development of a Control System for a Lower Limb Exoskeleton Rehabilitation Robot for Stroke Patients with Standing Instability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Lower-limb exoskeleton robots can medically assist stroke patients in standing and walking, but there is little research on lower-limb exoskeleton robots that assist in standing balance. In this paper, we design the system of a lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot that can assist in standing balance. We performed kinematic modeling with OpenSim and forward dynamics simulation with SCONE. Having identified the muscle groups and joints that affect standing balance more significantly. This paper focuses on the effects of the hip and iliopsoas muscles on standing balance. We have developed a control system for a lower-limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot that realizes: when inputting a hip joint change angle signal, an opposite moment and angle are output to control the lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot to assist the patient to achieve standing balance. The robotic system was simulated and analyzed using Matlab and the results showed the effectiveness of the system to keep the patient in standing balance.

articleTitle: Research on Power Load Forecasting Based on a Time Convolutional Network-Autoencoder Stacked Extreme Learning Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: As an indispensable basic resource for human survival and production, electricity plays a crucial role in ensuring global sustainable development. Therefore, how to accurately predict the power load to ensure the stability of the power supply has become an urgent challenge. In this study, a power load forecasting model fused with TCN and Autoencoder Stacked Extreme Learning Machine (AESELM) is proposed. First, the TCN model is utilized to effectively capture the long-term dependencies in the time series data, while the AESELM model is introduced to deal with the nonlinear features in the power load data. Then, the NRBO algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the TCN-AESELM model to further enhance the model performance. The experimental results show that the NRBO-TCN-AESELM model achieves the optimal results in the generalized evaluation metrics compared with the traditional models. In terms of root mean square error (RMSE), the NRBO-TCN-AESELM model reduces the RMSE metrics by 29.92%, 24.90%, and 18.47%, respectively, compared with ELM, LSTM, and TCN, which verifies that the model has a better prediction effect.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Heading Control for Wave Glider
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Wave glider(WG) is a kind of rigid-flexible coupled marine unmanned aerial vehicle, and accurate heading control is the key to ensuring navigation safety. The complex marine environment in which the wave glider navigates, the nonlinearity of the maneuvering response model, and the difficulty of debugging the control system during navigation are the problems faced by heading control. To this end, an adaptive backstepping control strategy is proposed to improve the accuracy and robustness of heading control. Through numerical simulation, the performance of adaptive backstepping heading control for wave gliders is analyzed under the conditions of no interference and time-varying interference, and it is compared with the traditional PID control strategy. The results show that, with the adaptive inverse stepping control strategy, the heading holding accuracy of the wave glider can reach 0.03deg, and the fastest heading response time can reach 13s, which improves the accuracy by 24%, the response time by 73.34%, and the average absolute error by at least 11.4% compared with the traditional PID control. The simulation results demonstrate that the adaptive backstepping control law is simple to derive and has good tracking performance, response performance, and robustness in wave glider heading control.

articleTitle: The Electrical Control System for The Automatic Plug-seedling Feeding Device of Pepper Transplanting Machine Based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: To address the issue of manually placing plug-seedlings into the seedling feeding mechanism in current pepper transplanting machines, and considering the high cost of electromechanical systems, this paper presents a design for an automatic plug-seedling feeding and plug-seedling cell feeding system based on Arduino. The system employs three stepper motors and thirteen cylinders working in coordination to achieve automatic plug-seedling transportation and synchronized plug-seedling cell feeding. Using the Arduino IDE, a control program was developed, and an electrical control system was constructed, followed by plug-seedling delivery experiments. The experimental results indicate that when the plug-seedling carrier is inclined at 35°, the delivery success rate reaches 93.74%. The system is reliable and stable, offering new ideas for future automation control.

articleTitle: Back Propagation Neural Network Based Positional Positive Solution for Wave Compensation Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In this paper, a method for solving the kinematic positive solution of a wave compensation device based on a rope traction parallel mechanism using a BP neural network is proposed. By using the kinematic inverse solution of the rope traction parallel mechanism derived from the Monte Carlo method as the training sample of the BP neural network, the kinematic positive solution of the position of the load platform based on the rope traction parallel wave compensating device is solved, which overcomes the disadvantage that the accuracy of the solution when using the numerical solution method has a direct relationship with the selection of the initial value, as compared with the traditional numerical method. It not only eliminates the tedious mathematical derivation process, but also obtains the positive solution of the position in accordance with the accuracy requirements. The position solved by neural network can be directly applied in the control system of active wave compensation device.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Data Assets Based on Fusion Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach for enterprise data asset processing, based on the Random Forest (RF) algorithm integrated with Back Propagation (BP) neural networks, to address the challenge of large-scale, high reliability, and real-time requirements for power grid data asset information management that traditional methods are unable to meet. This method not only ensures the reliability and timeliness of data processing, but also enhances the efficiency of data processing, playing a significant role in the scientific and rational exploration of the value of big data for enterprises. By utilizing the Random Forest algorithm classifier to categorize data types of the power grid and inputting them into the BP neural network for analysis and learning, the proposed algorithm, when integrated into the construction of an enterprise digital asset management system, yields corresponding results for system service requirements. Experimental results demonstrate that the processing time of cloud-edge collaborative data is significantly shorter than that of cloud computing, and the classification accuracy of the proposed technology exceeds 92%. Moreover, the load forecasting results exhibit minimal errors, thereby substantiating the effectiveness and reliability of this technology.

articleTitle: Group-Mix SAM: Lightweight Segmentation Solution for Industrial Implementations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Since its emergence in early 2023, Segment Anything Model(SAM) has garnered significant academic interests and spawned many investigations from various perspectives due to its zero-shot generalization ability. However, the deployment of SAM in scenes that required real-time performance, such as industrial assembly liners, had severe challenges due to its heavy image encoder, whose parameters were as large as 632M. In this study, we proposed a lightweight segmentation solution for industrial assembly line applications, wherein the heavyweight image encoder was replaced with a lightweight one. Specifically, we employed decoupled distillation to train the encoder of MobileSAM in a resource-limited setting. The entire knowledge distillation experiment could be completed in a single day on a single RTX 4090. The resulting lightweight SAM, called Group- Mix SAM, had 37.63% (2.16M) fewer parameters and 42.5% (15614.7M) fewer floating-point operations compared to MobileSAM. Additionally, on our homemade industrial dataset: MALD, its mIoU was only marginally lower than that of MobileSAM, at 0.615. Finally, we conducted comprehensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority of Group-Mix SAM in real industrial scenes.

articleTitle: Garbage Image Classification Based on Improved ShuffleNet Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Aims to address the problems of low accuracy of existing garbage classification and low classification ac curacy of models, large model size and difficulty of deployment on portable devices. A lightweight garbage image classification model is proposed by merging the improved lightweight model ShuffleNet V2 and MobileViT. Firstly, the structure of the ShuffleNet V2 model is adjusted and improved to enhance the cross-channel information interaction ability of the model, which improves the feature information interaction ability between the channels of the ShuffleNet V 2 model; secondly, the improved ShuffleNet V2 model is fused with the MobileViT model, the advantage of the MobileViT module in global feature information extraction is used to overcome the shortcomings of the ShuffleNet V2 network, which is difficult to extract global feature information. Comparative experiments are conducted on public datasets to evaluate the performance of the model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed SNViT model is significantly better than the D enseNet-121 model, and also has a better classification performance compared to EfficientNet V2, MobileNet V2 and other models, while the precision rate, recall rate and F1 value are also improved. The improved SNViT model improves the accuracy of the image classification task and achieves high classification performance, while the number of parameters is small and easy to train and deploy.

articleTitle: Research on Sentiment Analysis Method of Fan Culture Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Fan culture is a popular youth subculture phenomenon in recent years, and analyzing and monitoring the deviant behaviors within fan culture plays an important role in social governance. This paper proposes a sentiment analysis method for Weibo comments based on Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM) by combining the adaptive feature extraction capability of CNN with the long-distance information processing characteristics of LSTM. A training set is constructed by crawling online comments on recent hot fan culture topics, and the text is then preprocessed into vectors. Comparative experiments show that the proposed model achieves an emotion prediction accuracy rate of over 85%, indicating that this method can effectively analyze Weibo comments.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Wind Power Forecasting for Offshore Wind Farms Based on VMD and Optimized RFR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Wind power presents typical time series characteristics, and the output power of offshore wind power is affected by many factors. In order to improve the accuracy of offshore wind power prediction, the study used random forest regression (Random Forest Regression, RFR) technology, combined with variational mode decomposition (Variational Mode Decomposition, VMD) method to handle the time series characteristics of wind power. First, an RFR-based offshore wind power prediction model was established, and the model parameters were optimized by grid search and K-fold cross-validation techniques. Then, the variational mode decomposition (VMD) method is applied to decompose the data to generate a series of intrinsic mode components (IMFs) with different frequencies, and each component maintains a stationary state. The components were input into the optimized RFR model. The experimental results show that the MSE of VMD-RFR combination model is 2.972, R² is 0.976, MAPE is 1.027 and MAE is 1.260; compared with LSTM, VMD-LSTM, CEEMD-RFR, the prediction accuracy is significantly improved, which can solve the problem of low wind power prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance Impact of Large Deformation on Mobile Wellhead Platform 163
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Combined with part of the research content of Guangxi key research and development plan "Research and Development and engineering demonstration application of mobile wellhead platform in marginal oil field Weizhou in Beibu Gulf",this paper studies the performance of mobile wellhead offshore platform 163 with large deformation to ensure the safety of the platform. It includes establishing the finite element model of the movable wellhead platform, conducting modal analysis,searching the phase Angle under the action of wind and waves,and obtaining the phase Angle under the maximum working condition.Then the analysis under the action of wind wave and current alone,and the analysis considering p-delta and inertia force separately and simultaneously.The influence of different factors on the platform under large deformation is obtained, and the safety of the platform is checked under the maximum working condition.

articleTitle: Vortex-induced Vibration of Two Rigidly Coupled Tandem Cylinders: A Numerical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: This study explores the intricate mechanical mechanisms underlying vortex-induced vibrations by employing the multi-body force element theory. Numerical simulations are conducted on a 2-DOF rigidly coupled double-cylinder sys-tem, considering a uniform incoming flow with a Reynolds number of Re = 150, a mass ratio of m∗ = 2, a damping ratio of ζ = 0, and an aspect ratio L/D = 4. The vortex force analysis, which based on the force element theory and quantifies the contributions of all fluid elements with non-zero vorticity to the force exerted on the cylinders. The results indicate that the force contribution due to vortex-induced vibrations within the lock-in region differs from that outside of it. Moreover, as the vortex shedding pattern changes, the distribution of the force element components also varies.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting for Electric Propulsion Vessels Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: A prediction method is proposed based on RBF neural network through in-depth study of power load of ships. Before predicting the ship's power load, it is necessary to pre-process various data of the ship, screen and clean the abnormal data, and then normalise the normal samples, and finally construct a model to process the data and optimise the model according to the results. Various data of an electric propulsion ship are selected as the input reference of the model, and a prediction model is established using Matlab. The design method is shown to be one of the methods with high prediction accuracy according to the experimental results, and shows high model credibility in prediction.

articleTitle: An Improved NGO Algorithm for Optimizing VMD-CNN-BILSTM-Cross Attention Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Precisely identifying the fault-related operating state of the gear-box bearing represents a vital problem within industrial production. A bearing fault diagnosis method based on effectively improved NGO algorithm optimized VMD and CNN-BILSTM-Cross Attention is proposed for bearing fault diagnosis. The method improves the NGO algorithm by introducing the SMP chaotic mapping to initialize the eagle swarm distribution, introducing the sine function and the inverse learning strategy to enhance the algorithm’s computational precision and search ability. The CNN-BILSTM model is integrated with the Cross Attention module, which aims to merge the bearing signal features in multiple ways and boost the model’s accuracy and robustness. The improved SCNGO algorithm is utilized to iteratively optimize crucial parameters, namely the intrinsic mode coefficient, and the quadratic penalty term [K, α]within the VMD denoising technology. The CNN is responsible for seizing the spatial features of the bearing vibration signal at diverse frequencies, while the BILSTM is in charge of capturing the temporal features of the same signal. Moreover, the Cross Attention mechanism is introduced to blend the spatial features extracted by the CNN and the temporal features obtained by the BILSTM. In comparison to other models, the proposed model demonstrates stronger generalization and robustness.

articleTitle: Advanced Watershed Water Level Prediction Method Based on an Enhanced Informer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization and industrialization, the problems of water pollution and water scarcity are becoming more and more serious, and climate change and human activities have led to the increasing unpredictability of water levels in river basins. Water level prediction is of great significance in water resources management and disaster prevention and mitigation. In this study, a watershed water level prediction method based on improved Informer is proposed. The parameters of the Informer model are optimized by improving the honey badger optimization algorithm (HBA) to enhance the accuracy of the water level prediction model. Specifically, Chebyshev chaotic mapping initialization, Gaussian variation strategy and lens imaging reverse learning strategy are introduced into the original HBA algorithm to avoid falling into local extremes, which effectively improves the ability of exploring and exploiting in the optimization process of the algorithm parameters. The experimental results show that the model proposed in this paper exhibits higher accuracy and stability in water level prediction, which is of great practical significance and long-term value for water resources management, flood control and disaster warning.

articleTitle: Identification of Haploid Maize Seeds Using Efficient Channel Attention with Selective Kernel Networks and Multi-layer Stacked Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: This study focuses on the recognition of maize haploid seeds using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A dataset comprising 3,000 maize seed images, consisting of 1,230 haploid maize seed images and 1,770 diploid maize seed images, was utilized for experimentation. Classical CNN models, including VGG, AlexNet, ResNet, and SKNet, were employed to compare their effectiveness in haploid maize seed recognition. Additionally, this study proposes the ECA-SKEnsemble model, which enhances the SKNet architecture by replacing its fully connected layer with a one-dimensional convolution, thus reducing model complexity. The ECA-SKEnsemble integrates multiple instances of the ECA-SKNet model, each trained with different initializations and training techniques. By combining these models using ensemble techniques such as weighted voting or averaging, ECA-SKEnsemble achieves superior performance in maize seed recognition. The model attained an accuracy of 93.04%, outperforming standard CNN architectures, including VGG and ResNet. This work demonstrates the effectiveness of ensemble learning combined with efficient channel attention for improving maize seed recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhanced-AlexNet for Smart Detection of Tomato Seedling Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: The accurate identification of seedling diseases in tomato plants is crucial for ensuring optimal crop yields and agricultural productivity. However, traditional image identification methods often rely on visual inspection and experience, can lead to misdiagnosis and inappropriate pesticide use, thereby affecting both yield and quality. This paper addresses this challenges by presenting an Enhanced-AlexNet model designed to improve the identification of tomato seedling diseases through advanced image analysis techniques. The Enhanced-AlexNet model improved the overfitting problem of the standard AlexNet network model by using data augmentation and random inactivation of partial neurons. The model was trained using ten types of tomato data and a total of 4600 images were used, with 70% allocated for training and 30% for testing. Through comprehensive testing, with the original AlexNet model, LeNet model and the ResNet model our proposed model showed better performance than other network models and the overfitting problem of the original AlexNet model was greatly improved after improvement. The accuracy of the Enhanced-AlexNet model is 95.8%, which is 2.4% higher than the original model making it more effective in providing early and accurate disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Non-Heritage Film and Television Viewing Based on ADABOOST-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Television dramas serve as an important medium for the dissemination of intangible cultural heritage. However, the film and television big data face challenges such as a singular data storage model, inefficient data processing methods, and outdated data analysis techniques. These issues hinder the ability to meet the demands of applications that require vast amounts of data, particularly in analyzing television ratings, which negatively impacts the global dissemination of intangible culture. To address this, this paper employs machine learning methods to process and analyze film and television big data, thereby enhancing the efficiency of data processing and the accuracy of viewing predictions. Specifically, we utilize the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm and the AdaBoost-BP algorithm to classify and predict television drama viewership levels and ratings. By applying these algorithms to reduced-dimension feature data from television dramas, we aim to establish a viewership prediction model. Furthermore, we will compare the predictive outcomes to summarize more effective forecasting algorithms. The results indicate that the AdaBoost-BP algorithm is more robust than the SVM algorithm, indicating that the SVM algorithm still has certain limitations in solving big data analysis problems. The predicted viewership level of AdaBoost-BP is 70%, and the root mean square error of the predicted viewership is less than 20%. While the AdaBoost-BP algorithm has more advantages in massive data analysis scenarios.

articleTitle: Study on Surface Crack Closure Behavior of Ship Hull Plate Structures under Constant and Variable Amplitude Low-Cycle Fatigue Loading
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Based on in-depth analysis of crack closure theory and finite element simulation, this paper analyzes the crack closure behavior under constant and variable amplitude loading, and determines how the stress ratio and elliptical shape factor affect the closure process of the crack surface. Under constant and variable amplitude loading, the stress-strain response at the crack tip tends to be stable with the increase of cycles; however, after the introduction of single-peak overload, the stress-strain response at the crack tip changes significantly, and the crack closure effect is significantly enhanced during the unloading process, reflecting that single-peak overload has a decisive effect on crack closure behavior and the final crack growth rate. The relationship between crack growth rate and opening load for different combinations of overload and stress ratios reveals the complexity of crack closure behavior under overload conditions. These findings not only illustrate the protective effect of crack closure on crack growth, but also provide new understanding for predicting crack growth behavior under different overload conditions.

articleTitle: Prediction of Energy Efficiency and Environmental Sustainability in Greenhouse Tomato Production: Insights and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Greenhouse tomato production is a vital sector in modern agriculture, providing a controlled environment to optimize yield and quality. However, the high energy consumption associated with greenhouse operations raises concerns about environmental sustainability, particularly regarding greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This study develops a comprehensive neural network model to predict both tomato yield and GHG emissions, integrating key inputs such as heating energy, cooling energy, lighting energy, fertilizers, and water usage. The model was trained and validated using data from greenhouse operations, demonstrating effective learning and rapid convergence, stopping at epoch 11 out of 1000 with a final performance metric (mean squared error) of 0.00374 and a gradient of 0.0936. The results show that the model can accurately predict yield and GHG emissions, with the best validation performance achieved at epoch 5 (MSE = 0.3523). The model's predictions closely follow the trends of actual data, as illustrated by a relatively strong training correlation (R=0.78262) and moderate overall correlation (R=0.56593). Error histograms indicate that most predictions are close to actual values, though there are areas for further refinement. This dual-focus approach to optimizing productivity and environmental sustainability offers significant potential for enhancing resource use efficiency in greenhouse agriculture.

articleTitle: Design and Research of a Magnetorheological Robot Calf Based on Fuzzy Switchable Damping Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Overcoming the effects of terrestrial force on the bot and the person who wears it, and to impart compliant characteristics to the robot, a new calf structure for a lower limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot has been designed by combining the advantages of Magnetorheological Dampers(MRD) characterised by human calf muscles. A mathematical model of the Variable Stiffness and Damping Actuator(VSDA) was established, and its working principle was analyzed. A fuzzy controller was designed, integrating fuzzy control with switched damping control. Comparative simulation analysis revealed that fuzzy switched damping control offers better performance in terms of human stability and compliance.

articleTitle: Research on the Applicability of Convolutional Neural Network Models in the Integration of Industry and Education in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: At present, the integration effect of industry and education in vocational schools is not satisfactory, and there are still a series of problems in the integration process, such as inconsistency, lack of cooperation, lack of close coordination, and insufficient cooperation, which cause the integration of industry and education to become superficial. This study focuses on constructing and validating an evaluation index system for the integration of industry and education in vocational colleges. It also proposes an evaluation algorithm based on convolutional neural networks. The algorithm uses convolutional neural networks to determine the fusion evaluation score and obtain the corresponding evaluation level. The effectiveness of the proposed evaluation algorithm was demonstrated through instance testing. The evaluation index system developed in this research is rational and provides significant guidance for improving the integration of industry and education in vocational schools.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Posture Based on Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Recognition of motion postures has been a highly popular research field, aiming to analyze and identify human movements and behavior patterns through observations and description using natural language and other methods. This study introduces a posture motion feature extraction algorithm that incorporates spatiotemporal weighting and utilizes a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) approach. The algorithm extracts spatiotemporal motion key frames from selected motion samples and presents them as static images. It then performs initial motion image preprocessing, such as motion target detection and image enhancement, and vectorizes motion features using CNN. The spatiotemporal weighted adaptive interpolation method is employed to minimize errors in motion edge detection, enabling the extraction of posture motion features by combining posture edge features and spatiotemporal features. The extraction results are presented as the output. Comparative experiments with traditional algorithms demonstrate that the proposed neural network intelligent recognition algorithm not only achieves intelligent recognition of motion postures but also improves overall accuracy and reduces computational load compared to some other algorithms.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Reconstruction of Wire-structured Optical Welds and Point Cloud Filtering Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Three-dimensional reconstruction of weld surfaces is essential for evaluating weld quality. However, the fixed positions of the camera and laser light source prevent direct reconstruction within the camera's coordinate system using line structured light scanning. To address this, we mounted the camera and laser light source on a six-axis robot and calibrated the transformation matrix between the base and camera coordinate systems. This setup allows us to generate a point cloud representing the weld surface within the base coordinate system. Considering the specific characteristics of 3D reconstruction and the topographic features of weld surfaces, we developed a reduced-dimensional point cloud filtering method. Comparative analysis with traditional filtering algorithms shows that this method effectively eliminates isolated and cluster noise, ensuring accurate topographic reconstruction of weld surfaces.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 Factory Safety Wearable Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In industrial scenarios, the YOLOv8 algorithm is difficult to extract key features due to the complexity of background information in images such as helmets, safety vests, and gloves, and is prone to problems such as missed detection and false detection. The C2f_MSCA structure is constructed to replace the C2f module in the Backbone network of YOLOv8 to improve the key feature extraction ability of the Backbone network. The visual information contained in the small target objects in the dataset is very limited, it is difficult to capture its features, and it is easy to be covered by complex backgrounds. A GS_Head detection branch is added to the Head part to enhance the learning ability of small targets. The receptive field attention convolution is used in the neck, which reduces background interference by adjusting the response of the feature map in the dataset and ignoring the region unrelated to the target. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the mean average precision (mAP) by 1.2 compared with the original YOLOv8 model, which effectively improves the performance of the model.

articleTitle: Impact of Online Education on Academic Performance in Sino-Foreign Joint Programs during COVID-19 Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In the context of normalized COVID-19 prevention, online teaching models have been widely adopted in higher education institutions. To assess the impact of online teaching during the pandemic on students in Sino-foreign joint programs, a quasi-experiment combining prospective and retrospective methods was designed using the Circuit Principles course at a certain university as an example. Participants were divided into online teaching and offline teaching groups, with comprehensive analyzes conducted using self-efficacy questionnaires, academic engagement scales, and final grades. The study found that the academic performance of the online teaching group was lower and there were significant differences in academic self-efficacy and engagement compared to the offline teaching group. The study revealed multiple challenges faced by online teaching, such as reduced teaching interaction, limited teaching resources, and decreased student engagement, but also provided directions and opportunities to explore new online teaching models. This paper aims to provide practical references and suggestions for online teaching in Sino-foreign joint programs during future public health emergencies.

articleTitle: Utilizing Spatial Transformers and GRU for Temporal Context in 3D Human Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for 3D human pose estimation by integrating spatial multi-scale features with GRU-based temporal multi-scale encoding. Our method addresses the limitations of existing single-stage and multi-stage approaches by enhancing feature extraction and reducing redundancy. We replace the HRNet fusion layer with a multi-resolution module that generates multi-scale features through parallel branches. Temporal multi-scale encoding further refines the 3D poses by adaptively selecting information based on relationships between different resolutions. Experimental results on the Human3.6M and COCO datasets show our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 43.6 mm and 35.4 mm MPJPE on Protocol #1 and Protocol #2 respectively, and an AP of 75.2 on the COCO val 2017 dataset. These results demonstrate significant improvements in pose estimation accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Intelligent Speech Enhancement Algorithm Model Based on Recorded Classroom Audio
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: With advancements in communication technology, there is increasing demand for high-quality voice communication and accurate speech recognition. In the complex acoustic environment of a recording classroom, noise, reverberation and other interferences can seriously affect the quality and intelligibility of the picked-up target speech signal, which in turn affects the effectiveness of the subsequent speech communication and recognition, so it is crucial to enhance the target speech signal in order to satisfy people's demand for clear and recognizable speech information. In this paper, based on the network model of Deep Complex Convolutional Recurrent Network (DCCRN), we introduce the F-T-LSTM structure to more accurately describe the correlation between the time and frequency domains of speech, and at the same time, we integrate the channel attention mechanism and the spatial attention mechanism to carry out a more comprehensive feature extraction of the speech features in the complex domain, and we skillfully concentrate the computational power in the area with the most feature-rich information, so that the quality and intelligibility of speech signals under the complex domain are significantly improved. significantly improve the overall performance of speech enhancement networks in the complex domain.

articleTitle: A Smart Hybrid Model for Fruit Quality Grading: Merging Canny Edge Detection and K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Fruit recognition and grading are essential steps in fruit quality screening. In this research, a novel approach that combines the power of Canny edge detection and K-means clustering algorithms for fruit quality grading is proposed. The application of multi-channel clustering to process fruit images enables effective separation of the main body and background, followed by feature extraction through contour detection and filtering. Moreover, a Transfer Learning model utilizing an 18-layer residual neural network is trained to perform fruit classification, while digital image processing techniques are employed to extract relevant image features for fruit grading. To evaluate the accuracy and efficiency of our method, a dataset of 2,000 images was utilize to conduct the fruit recognition and grading experiments using Matlab software. The experimental results using apple samples show that our approach achieves a recognition accuracy of 95% and reduces processing time to less than one second, significantly improving efficiency in real-time applications.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Vortex-Induced Vibration in Inclined Elliptic Cylinders for Marine Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Vortex-induced vibration (VIV), as a typical fluid-structure interaction phenomenon, is widely observed in marine engineering structures. Due to its resonant characteristics, it has the potential to generate substantial hydrodynamic energy and is considered as a novel approach for energy development. This study employs the force element method to perform numerical simulations of VIV for an elliptic cylinder inclined at an angle of θ = 45° with two degrees of freedom, under the Reynolds number Re = 200, mass ratio m* = 10, reduced velocity Ur = 1~14, and damping ratio ξ = 0. The results are compared with those of a circular cylinder under the same parameters. The findings indicate that, when locked in, the elliptic cylinder exhibits a significant amplification in transverse amplitude compared to the circular cylinder, with a delayed and wider locking range. Additionally, the contribution of the volume vorticity lift coefficient (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">lv</inf>) is stronger for the elliptic cylinder than for the circular cylinder. The elliptic cylinder at a 45° inclination demonstrates a pronounced excitation effect compared to the circular cylinder. In engineering applications, stimulating the efficiency of marine current energy generation devices can be achieved by installing inclined elliptic cylinder fairings.

articleTitle: TGC-YOLO: Detection Model for Small Objects in UAV Image Scene
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In the field of drone target detection, existing object detection models often have problems of missed detection and false detection when dealing with challenges such as scale changes, dense targets and irregular arrangement of small targets. Therefore, this paper proposes a new detection model TGC-YOLO. Firstly, the EMA attention mechanism module is introduced to encode global information, and pixel-level features are further aggregated through dimensional interaction, which effectively reduces the attention to irrelevant information and maintains good feature extraction capabilities. Secondly, in terms of network structure, the FasterBlock module is used to replace the traditional BottleNeck module in C2f in YOLOv8n, so as to design a lightweight FasterC2f module, which reduces the number of parameters while ensuring the accuracy of the model. Thirdly, the Slim-neck structure is adopted on the Neck layer, and the model's detection ability for small objects is enhanced through the combination of GSConv and VoV-GSCSP. Then, the TGC three-channel feature fusion structure is designed based on GSConv to effectively aggregate multi-scale feature maps, enhance the feature fusion ability of the model, and improve the performance of small target detection. Finally, the dynamic head (DyHead) based on the attention mechanism is introduced to further improve the accuracy of small target detection by combining the three attention mechanisms of scale, space and task. Compared with YOLOv8n, TGC-YOLO has achieved 7.7%, 6.8% and 7.4% improvement in mAp@50, Precision and Recall respectively. Meanwhile, the model size is reduced by 0.1MB, enabling fast and accurate detection of small targets.

articleTitle: A Secure Communication Mechanism Scheme for the Internet of Things Based on Chebyshev Chaotic Map
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: With the escalating number and magnitude of Internet of Things(IoT) devices, communication security between device entities has become an important issue. In the IoT, the sharing of real-time data through open channels poses the risk of unauthorized access by attackers, resulting in privacy breaches. Addressing these challenges, user identity authentication serves as the primary line of defense for security in the IoT environment. Therefore, this article proposes a secure communication mechanism. Firstly, the protocol adopts a three-factor authentication method and uses Chebyshev chaotic mapping, symmetric encryption, hash function, and XOR operation to achieve secure authentication between the server and the user. Then the protocol establishes a session key and ensures secure communication between both parties. Security analysis of the protocol is conducted. The findings indicate that the protocol supports various security requirements, including forward security, and exhibits significant enhancements in security. By comparing the performance of this protocol with similar protocols, it was found that this protocol requires fewer computing and communication resources, ensuring operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Financial System Risk Warning Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: As the global economy transitions towards a trajectory of high-quality development, the underlying risks within the financial system are becoming increasingly conspicuous. To precisely identify and effectively address these risks, this paper introduces a financial system risk warning based on a deep learning model. The objective is to notably enhance the accuracy of predicting enterprise financial risks and improve the responsiveness of the warning mechanism. In this study, we harness the strengths of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) to develop an efficient CNN-LSTM model. Through rigorous experimental validation and analysis, CNN-LSTM model exhibits outstanding performance in the task of financial risk warning. It not only enhances the precision of early warning but also significantly bolsters the stability and reliability of the warning system.

articleTitle: AI Mediated Surface Waste Auto-Detection on Water Bodies Using Cutting Edge Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: The proliferation of surface waste in water bodies poses significant environmental and ecological challenges. Traditional methods of waste detection are often labor-intensive and limited in scope. This paper presents a novel approach to surface waste detection using artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced imaging technologies. Leveraging cutting-edge techniques such as deep learning algorithms, high- resolution satellite imagery, and real-time data processing, our system offers an automated solution for identifying and monitoring waste in water bodies. We developed a robust AI model trained on diverse datasets, including satellite and drone-captured images, to detect various types of surface waste with high accuracy. The system integrates real-time processing capabilities to provide timely alerts and actionable insights for environmental management. Evaluation results demonstrate that our approach significantly improves detection accuracy and operational efficiency compared to conventional methods. This research contributes to the advancement of smart environmental monitoring systems and offers a scalable solution for mitigating the impact of surface waste on aquatic ecosystems.

articleTitle: State of Health Assessment of Lithium Batteries Based on Fusion Model and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Lithium battery State of Health (SOH) is crucial for stable operation and reducing failure risks. This paper identifies three key health features—IC curve peak value, constant voltage drop discharge time, and IC curve peak voltage—through Pearson correlation analysis. A multi-model fusion approach is utilized to construct and train three individual models: Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), Extreme Learning Machine (ELM), and Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM). Additionally, three pairwise fusion models—TCN-LSTM, TCN-ELM, and ELM-LSTM—and a comprehensive TCN-LSTM-ELM model are developed. Validation using NASA dataset shows that TCN-LSTM-ELM fusion model achieves the highest prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Ship Target Recognition Based on Improved Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Marine economy in China, the intelligent identification of ships is significant to Marine traffic safety. Conventional machine learning techniques exhibit low accuracy and slow performance in image object recognition tasks. In response to this issue, this paper proposes a ship target recognition method based on improved ResNet18. Firstly, a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) is added after the last convolutional layer in the network to enhance the feature extraction capability for ship targets. Additionally, GELU activation function and dropout are introduced to address overfitting caused by scarce dataset, utilizing data augmentation techniques. Lastly, a comparison of the improved residual model with those of other neural network models is made. The validation set precision of the improved ResNet18 model is 96.39%, which is 6.38%, 5.05%, 4.61% and 3.13% higher than that of AlexNet, VGGNet, GoogLeNet and ResNet18, respectively, according to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Bending Prediction Of Bulb Flat Steel By Neural Network Algorithm Based On SSA-BP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: facing the increasing demand for high-precision bending processing production in modern shipyards, the traditional control method of CNC rib Steel bending machine can not accurately control the angle of profile bending. This deficiency leads to increased processing errors and affects product quality. For this reason, this paper introduces a machine learning predictive control method and constructs a BP neural network (SSA-BP) prediction model based on the sparrow optimization algorithm. Firstly, the method of calculating the target bending point using the secant method is introduced, and then the bending data of bulb flat steel is obtained through experiments, from which the SSA-BP model is constructed and trained. The experimental results show that the sparrow algorithm can optimize the BP neural network model to improve the prediction accuracy and achieve effective bulb flat steel bending prediction.

articleTitle: Knowledge-Enhanced Contextual Auction Design Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: The optimal auction represents a fundamental challenge in auction design, primarily focused on maximizing the seller’s revenue. Recently, context-aware auction design has gained traction as it enhances the model’s understanding of the auction environment by incorporating contextual information about buyers and items. However, limited contextual information can hinder the model’s ability to capture potential correlations. Therefore, we propose a Knowledge-Enhanced Contextual Auction Design Model (KECA) based on neural networks. KECA aims to improve the comprehensive understanding of the auction environment by integrating external knowledge. Specifically, we first construct a structured knowledge graph of triples using Wikipedia. This knowledge graph is utilized to enhance the contextual feature representation of buyers and items, thereby providing a more comprehensive description of the information in the auction environment. Additionally, we employ the K-means clustering algorithm to enhance feature fusion between auction information and the knowledge graph within the locally sensitive hashing self-attention mechanism, thereby improving the model’s feature representation capabilities. Finally, extensive experimental results indicate that KECA outperforms current mainstream auction models under various settings, verifying the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: Wind Power Prediction based on Multivariate and Convolutional Neural Network-Fast Deep Stacked Network Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Accurate wind power prediction can optimize the scheduling of electric power resources, reduce the scheduling pressure due to wind power fluctuations, and contribute to better planning of power grid operation to ensure the stability and security of the power grid. Traditional ELM is difficult to accurately characterize the complex relationship between environmental factors and wind power, and considering that the problem of poor solvability of multivariate data may affect the hardness of wind power prediction, this study proposes a hybrid wind power prediction model based on Random Forest (RF) feature selection, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Fast Deep Stacked Network Extreme Learning Machine (FDSNELM). Firstly, RF is used to select features for multivariate wind power data to screen out the influencing factors with strong correlation with the wind power data; secondly, CNN is used to extract features for historical multivariate wind power data; then, the feature-extracted wind power data are used as inputs to the FDSNELM model to predict the future wind power. The wind power data of wind farms in Yunnan province in December 2020 is taken as the research object, and the RF-CNN-FDSNELM model proposed in this paper is compared with the BP, ELM, TCN, FDSNELM, and CNN-FDSNELM models. The results show that the RF-CNN-FDSNELM model established in this study has higher prediction accuracy and higher stability, and can be better applied to wind power prediction.

Author Keywords: fast deep stacked network extreme learning machine

articleTitle: Online Multi-Object Tracking Based On Global Feature Enhancement Network And Historical Feature Complement Iteration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Multi-object tracking is an important part of computer vision and plays a crucial role in many real-world application scenarios. The existing integrated tracking framework loses the key features of the target when fusing features and iteratively updating the trajectory apparent features, resulting in tracking instability. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes an online multi-object tracking method based on global feature enhancement network and historical feature complement iteration. In this method, a dual global feature fusion unit is used to replace the global feature enhancement network of summation or splicing operation, which is used to extract more discriminative key features and enhance the recognition ability of objects in multiple scenes. In addition, the historical features are used to supplement the iterative mechanism, which introduces random features and average features from the historical appearance features stored in the trajectory as supplementary features to supplement the lack of object features in the current frame. Comprehensive experiments are carried out on MOT15, MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20 datasets, in which the MOTA score of 73.2% is achieved on MOT16 dataset, indicating that the proposed method has good tracking performance. Source code: http://github.com/Anbping/gfen-hfci

articleTitle: Digital Meter Detection and Reading Recognition Based on Improved YOLOv9
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low precision, high cost and poor timeliness of traditional digital instrument detection and reading recognition methods in petrochemical explosion environment, a digital instrument detection network and character detection and recognition network based on improved YOLOv9 are proposed. Firstly, the original backbone network is replaced by a lightweight Mobilenetv2 network, which is used to extract the instrument feature information and reduce the parameters and computational complexity of the model. Then, iRMB attention mechanism is embedded to enhance the feature representation and perception ability of the network and improve the model efficiency. Finally, the HWD_Adown downsampling module is designed to include as much information as possible in the downsampling process and improve the detection accuracy. The experimental results show that the number of parameters of the improved identification method is obviously reduced on the test set, and the average accuracy of instrument detection (mAP50) reaches 88.5%, which is 2.2% higher than the original model, and the effect is remarkable in digital instrument positioning. The average accuracy of character recognition (mAP50) reaches 98.8%.

articleTitle: Advanced Email Security with NLP and the Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Email security is crucial in today’s digital age, as it serves as the primary means of communication for individuals and businesses alike. Therefore, it is vulnerable to various cyber threats like phishing, malware, and spam. These threats can lead to data breaches, financial losses, and the theft of private information. This study introduces a comprehensive approach to detect unusual patterns in emails using artificial intelligence. It specifically emphasizes the integration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and the Isolation Forest algorithm. Key contributions encompass techniques for gathering and organizing email datasets, the utilization of TF-IDF vectorization to transform email text into numerical characteristics, the integration of the Isolation Forest algorithm to detect anomalies in email behavior, and the assessment of model effectiveness through metrics like Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC. In addition, the system demonstrates excellent scalability, flexibility, and accuracy when it comes to real-world email security scenarios. This demonstrates the effectiveness of combining natural language processing (NLP) with machine learning (ML) to enhance email security and offers a robust solution for detecting and mitigating cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: -SLAM: A Visual SLAM Algorithm Based on Feature Mismatch Rejection and Map Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: For the ORB-SLAM2 algorithm in the mis-matching rejection has the blindness of processing and lead to the low efficiency of the algorithm and can only build sparse point cloud map can not meet the robot real-time localisation and path planning problems, this paper introduces the Progressive Sample Consensus (PROSAC) to improve the mis-matching rejection in the ORB-SLAM2 and add a dense point cloud and octree map construction thread to compensate for the loss of map information. The PRO-SLAM algorithm pre-orders the feature points by evaluation function, selects high-quality feature points to solve the uni-responsive matrix, and eliminates the false matches based on the matrix solution and error threshold to achieve accurate position estimation and re-localisation of the camera. Finally, the dense point cloud and octree map are constructed according to the selected key frames. Compared with the sparse point cloud map, the newly constructed map can be directly used for robot navigation and path planning. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm reduces the mis-match rejection time by about 50%, Mismatch rejection is more efficient, the error of the system is smaller, and the average Rmse of APE is reduced by 45.45%, indicating that the algorithm in this paper has higher positioning accuracy and better robustness.

articleTitle: Efficient Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning with Byzantine Robustness
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Federated learning is a distributed machine learning paradigm. It entails training a global model across diverse organizations while ensuring privacy constraints are upheld. Despite its promising potential, challenges arise when adversaries attempt to infer private information from exchanged parameters or compromise the global model. Although the development of multiple protocols to mitigate security threats, safeguarding the privacy of individual participants while countering Byzantine adversaries remains a challenge. Furthermore, the frequent transmission of gradients between the master server and participants results in significant communication overhead, thereby limiting the training efficiency of federated learning. In this study, We propose an efficient privacy-preserving federated learning scheme with Byzantine robustness (EFL-PB). For privacy protection and Byzantine robustness, we propose a novel aggregation strategy based on the multi-message shuffle protocol in differential privacy. For enhancing communication efficiency, we develop an adaptive gradient compression scheme. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that our multi-message shuffle protocol can satisfy differential privacy. Experimental results on the MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10 datasets validate the robustness and efficiency of the EFL-PB scheme. As well, the EFL-PB scheme exhibits strong performance on non-iid datasets.

articleTitle: Credit Value Based Autonomous Vehicles Joint Task Offloading Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: To address the issue of selfish behavior demonstrated by autonomous vehicles in vehicle-infrastructure cooperation, where vehicles having spare computing resources are disinclined to share them, we propose a vehicle selection-assisted computing scheme based on a credit value incentive mechanism. This scheme is aimed at resolving the reluctance of autonomous vehicles to supply their spare computing resources while also facilitating low-performance vehicles to participate effectively in task computing. Additionally, considering the optimization problem of delay and energy consumption during offloading and computing tasks for autonomous vehicles, we formulate a mathematical problem that integrates weighted sums of delay and energy consumption. To handle this problem, we propose a double populations adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm (DPAPSO) based on the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO). The DPAPSO forms two populations of particles in accordance with our model and utilizes different updating strategies for each population. Experimental results show that the proposed DPAPSO outperforms the traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm in terms of optimization effects within this model. Furthermore, it presents superior performance and stability compared to both the simulated annealing algorithm (SA) and the genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: Person Re-identification Method Based on Video Spatial Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Recently, video-based person re-identification has received more and more attention, and has played a very important role in public safety fields such as security monitoring and public security criminal investigation. However, it is still a great challenge for existing work to effectively overcome the occlusion problem and extract more abundant pedestrian spatial feature information. To tackle the problem of occlusion of pedestrians in real scenes, this paper proposes a person re-identification method based on video spatial feature enhancement. This method enhances the spatial information in video frames by using multi-angle feature aggregation of time attention and extracts continuous pedestrian detail features by using multi-frame spatial feature splicing of time domain information, so as to solve the difficult problem of pedestrian occlusion recognition. Experiments show that the proposed method has improved performance on MARS and DukeMTMC-VideoReID datasets, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method. The source code is available at https://github.com/sgzhi11/Video-Spatial-Feature-Enhancement.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Identification and Evaluation Method for Oyster Resources in Marine Pasture Rafting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In response to the problems of large sea areas, scattered breeding points and areas, time-consuming and labor-intensive manual statistical methods, and low accuracy in current marine ranch aquaculture, a set of artificial intelligence remote sensing recognition and evaluation methods is proposed to quickly and accurately evaluate the resources of oysters raised on large, scattered, and small target marine pasture rafts. Based on machine learning object recognition technology, a detection box generation method for rotation angle elements is proposed, and a pixel based intersection and union method is used to calculate the PIoU loss value of the target. The OysterRE model is proposed to comprehensively calculate and evaluate the resources of oyster farming in ocean pastures. The total resources of oyster farming in ocean pastures are calculated by multiplying the number of oyster farms by the biomass of individual oyster farms. The results indicate that: 1) A method for generating detection boxes based on rotation angle elements has been proposed, which enables the detection boxes to better match irregular targets under complex backgrounds; 2) Propose a pixel based intersection union method to calculate the IoU of the target, making the loss value sensitive to the size, position, and rotation angle of the annotated box, which is more conducive to non-maximum suppression control of the selection of detection boxes; 3) The AVG Recall of the OysterRE model is 0.73, which is 0.12 higher than the average recall of the YOLOv5 model of 0.61. This shows that the proposed model has better recognition performance for oyster farming rafts and consistent with the actual field investigation.

articleTitle: Pulmonary Nodule Detection and False Positive Reduction based on Mamba
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Pulmonary nodule detection is an important step in the early diagnosis of lung cancer, but due to the diverse morphology of nodules and the complexity of CT images, false positives often occur during the detection process. This paper proposes a pulmonary nodule detection method based on the Mamba network, including a preliminary detection network and an optimized detection network. The preliminary detection network achieves efficient feature extraction and multi-scale feature fusion through deep separable convolution, dilated convolution, spatial pyramid pooling (SPP) and selective sampling module (SSM). The optimized detection network combines ensemble learning and multi-task learning strategies to further reduce false positives and improve detection accuracy. We conducted comprehensive experiments on the Luna16 dataset and verified the effectiveness of the method through the CPM evaluation indicator. The ablation experiment results show that each module has made an important contribution to improving the detection performance.

articleTitle: RSSNet: A Novel Network Model for FRBs Search
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Fast Radio Brusts (FRBs) are often subjected to a large number of false-positive samples and radio-frequency interference (RFI) during the search process, making it difficult to achieve an efficient search. In order to optimize the search results and improve the search efficiency, this paper proposes a FRBs search network model which named RSSNet (Radio Source Search Network), and adopts the gradient-weighted class-activation mapping (Grad-CAM) method to provide an interpretable analysis for this model. At the same time, the influence of the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the dynamic spectral on the search is also studied, and the search results of dynamic spectra with high SNR (SNR ⩾ 11) and those with low SNR (SNR < 11) in the test set are compared and analyzed respectively. The experimental results show that RSSNet is the best in low SNR dynamic spectrum search compared with other networks, with an accuracy of 99.37%. Based on the above work, an automatic FRBs search system is designed to realize the automatic data reading and dynamic spectrum based FRBs recognition.

articleTitle: GAMJL: A Chinese Named Entity Recognition Method Based on Gated Attention Mechanism and Joint Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Chinese text, lacking clear word boundary delimiters, poses challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER). Existing methods extract character sequence features using external dictionaries or deep learning models, but often fail to filter shared features, which may lead the model to misjudge entity boundaries and incorporate irrelevant semantic information. This paper introduces a Chinese NER method based on a gated attention mechanism and joint learning. The model first encoded Chinese text using a pre-trained language model XLM-RoBerta, then obtained entity features and entity span features through a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory network (Bi-LSTM) and linear transformation layers. A gated attention mechanism was then constructed to filter a nd f use t he i nput f eatures. T he fused features significantly i mproved t he m odel’s a bility t o perceive entity types and spans. Experimental results on the Resume and MSRA public datasets showed that the proposed method outperformed other baseline models.

articleTitle: SERNet-T: A Smart Contract Multi-label Vulnerability Detection Model Based on SE Attention and One-Dimensional Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: The development of blockchain technology has expanded from its initial application in digital cryptocurrencies to a wider range of fields, especially smart contracts. However, security issues related to smart contracts remain a pressing challenge. Existing methods for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts have limitations, such as focusing only on specific types of vulnerabilities, limited computational resources, and high false positive rates. To address these issues, this paper proposes a smart contract multi-label vulnerability detection model based on SE attention and one-dimensional residual networks(SERNet-T). This network not only emphasizes functionality but also integrates improved SEBlock residual blocks and Transformer-encoder modules, which can efficiently extract complex features from smart contract bytecode and capture long-term dependencies. The SEBlock residual blocks in SERNet-T significantly enhance feature channel dependency, refine inter-channel responses, and improve the processing capability of critical information. Experimental results show that our method achieves 75.56% accuracy and 86.46% micro-average F1 score on public datasets, improving by 2.1% and 2.8 % compared to existing methods, respectively. Additionally, SERNet-T reduces the number of parameters by more than 20%.

articleTitle: WGS_YOLO_dual: A Detection Model for Strip Steel Surface Defects Based on Attention Mechanism and Spatial Pyramid Pooling Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Surface defect detection in strip steel is crucial for metal manufacturing and processing. Yet, current detection methods frequently lack precision. This paper introduces the WGS_YOLO_dual model, which leverages attention mechanisms and spatial pyramid pooling to enhance detection. The model incorporates a GAM module to fuse channel and spatial data, boosting interaction between dimensions. It also swaps out SPPELAN for SPPFCSPC in its backbone to manage varying defect scales more effectively. Additionally, it employs the WIOU loss function in place of CIOU to enhance accuracy. Tested on the NEU-DET dataset, WGS_YOLO_dual showed a 1.9% boost in mAP50, a 2.3% rise in mAP50-95, and an 0.8% increase in recall.

articleTitle: Clothes Changing Person Re-identification via Pose and Style Normalization Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: Re-identification involves identifying the same person across multiple non-overlapping cameras. Traditional methods rely heavily on pedestrian appearance, assuming consistent clothing in both query and gallery images, which is unrealistic in real-world scenarios where individuals often change clothes. To address this, we propose the Pose and Style Normalization Network (PSN-Net), which handles clothing and pose variations using adversarial generative networks and feature decoupling. Our model includes a Style Normalization (SN) module to eliminate style differences and a dual-channel feature matching module to enhance pedestrian matching. The results of the comparative and ablation experiments demonstrate that our model can effectively improve pedestrian recognition performance under clothing changes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Data Augmentation and Hierarchical LSTM for UAV Intent Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Cognitive Computing and Complex Data (ICCD)
abstract: In modern aerial warfare, situational awareness plays a critical role in enhancing combat effectiveness, and intent recognition in air combat is the core element for achieving this objective. Addressing the limitations of traditional air combat intent recognition methods in complex operational environments, this paper proposes a novel multitask intent recognition method based on feature enhancement.
